title: Poland's Crypto Law Fails a Third Time, Leaving the Only Gap in Europe
summary:

Friday’s vote, the third such attempt, fell 25 votes short of the three-fifths majority required to reverse his decision. Inside Poland’s Third Crypto Veto and Nawrocki’s Reasoning
The post Poland's Crypto Law Fails a Third Time, Leaving the Only Gap in Europe appeared first on BeInCrypto.
content: Poland has once again failed to pass national cryptocurrency regulation after lawmakers fell short of the required majority to override a presidential veto. This marks the third unsuccessful attempt to implement a regulatory framework, leaving Poland as the sole European Union member state without functioning rules aligned with broader regional standards.
